@name: Panhandler
@slug: panhandler
@source: sohk
@category: RMFRP School of Hard Knocks
@default_cost: 28
@description:
 [Vocational] The panhandler is a denizen of the city landscape. He makes a
 living by begging and taking handouts from others. A panhandler often has to
 disguise himself to avoid arousing anger in those he solicits for aid. A
 panhandler will do almost anything to better his position, even crawl into a
 dark cavern in search of a rumored treasure. Time to Acquire: 26 months.
 Starting Money: normal.
